verses.en: Remember now thy Creator in the days of thy youth, while the evil days come not, nor the years draw nigh, when thou shalt say, I have no pleasure in them;
verses.pt: Lembra-te também do teu Criador nos dias da tua mocidade, antes que venham os maus dias, e cheguem os anos em que dirás: Não tenho prazer neles;
verses.en_web: Remember also your Creator in the days of your youth, before the evil days come, and the years draw near, when you will say, “I have no pleasure in them”;
verses.en_bbe: Let your mind be turned to your Maker in the days of your strength, while the evil days come not, and the years are far away when you will say, I have no pleasure in them;

verses.en: While the sun, or the light, or the moon, or the stars, be not darkened, nor the clouds return after the rain:
verses.pt: antes que se escureçam o sol e a luz, e a lua, e as estrelas, e tornem a vir as nuvens depois da chuva;
verses.en_web: Before the sun, the light, the moon, and the stars are darkened, and the clouds return after the rain;
verses.en_bbe: While the sun, or the light, or the moon, or the stars, are not dark, and the clouds come not back after the rain;

verses.en: In the day when the keepers of the house shall tremble, and the strong men shall bow themselves, and the grinders cease because they are few, and those that look out of the windows be darkened,
verses.pt: no dia em que tremerem os guardas da casa, e se curvarem os homens fortes, e cessarem os moedores, por já serem poucos, e se escurecerem os que olham pelas janelas,
verses.en_web: in the day when the keepers of the house shall tremble, and the strong men shall bow themselves, and the grinders cease because they are few, and those who look out of the windows are darkened,
verses.en_bbe: In the day when the keepers of the house are shaking for fear, and the strong men are bent down, and the women who were crushing the grain are at rest because their number is small, and those looking out of the windows are unable to see;

verses.en: And the doors shall be shut in the streets, when the sound of the grinding is low, and he shall rise up at the voice of the bird, and all the daughters of musick shall be brought low;
verses.pt: e as portas da rua se fecharem; quando for baixo o ruído da moedura, e nos levantarmos à voz das aves, e todas as filhas da música ficarem abatidas;
verses.en_web: and the doors shall be shut in the street; when the sound of the grinding is low, and one shall rise up at the voice of a bird, and all the daughters of music shall be brought low;
verses.en_bbe: When the doors are shut in the street, and the sound of the crushing is low, and the voice of the bird is soft, and the daughters of music will be made low;

verses.en: Also when they shall be afraid of that which is high, and fears shall be in the way, and the almond tree shall flourish, and the grasshopper shall be a burden, and desire shall fail: because man goeth to his long home, and the mourners go about the streets:
verses.pt: como também quando temerem o que é alto, e houver espantos no caminho; e florescer a amendoeira, e o gafanhoto for um peso, e falhar o desejo; porque o homem se vai à sua casa eterna, e os pranteadores andarão rodeando pela praça;
verses.en_web: yes, they shall be afraid of heights, and terrors will be on the way; and the almond tree shall blossom, and the grasshopper shall be a burden, and desire shall fail; because man goes to his everlasting home, and the mourners go about the streets:
verses.en_bbe: And he is in fear of that which is high, and danger is in the road, and the tree is white with flower, and the least thing is a weight, and desire is at an end, because man goes to his last resting-place, and those who are sorrowing are in the streets;

verses.en: Or ever the silver cord be loosed, or the golden bowl be broken, or the pitcher be broken at the fountain, or the wheel broken at the cistern.
verses.pt: antes que se rompa a cadeia de prata, ou se quebre o copo de ouro, ou se despedace o cântaro junto à fonte, ou se desfaça a roda junto à cisterna,
verses.en_web: before the silver cord is severed, or the golden bowl is broken, or the pitcher is broken at the spring, or the wheel broken at the cistern,
verses.en_bbe: Before ever the silver cord is cut, or the vessel of gold is broken, or the pot is broken at the fountain, or the wheel broken at the water-hole;

verses.en: Then shall the dust return to the earth as it was: and the spirit shall return unto God who gave it.
verses.pt: e o pó volte para a terra como o era, e o espírito volte a Deus que o deu.
verses.en_web: and the dust returns to the earth as it was, and the spirit returns to God who gave it.
verses.en_bbe: And the dust goes back to the earth as it was, and the spirit goes back to God who gave it.

verses.en: Vanity of vanities, saith the preacher; all is vanity.
verses.pt: Vaidade de vaidades, diz o pregador, tudo é vaidade.
verses.en_web: “Vanity of vanities,” says the Preacher. “All is vanity!”
verses.en_bbe: All things are to no purpose, says the Preacher, all is to no purpose.

verses.en: And moreover, because the preacher was wise, he still taught the people knowledge; yea, he gave good heed, and sought out, and set in order many proverbs.
verses.pt: Além de ser sábio, o pregador também ensinou ao povo o conhecimento, meditando, e estudando, e pondo em ordem muitos provérbios.
verses.en_web: Further, because the Preacher was wise, he still taught the people knowledge. Yes, he pondered, sought out, and set in order many proverbs.
verses.en_bbe: And because the Preacher was wise he still gave the people knowledge; searching out, testing, and putting in order a great number of wise sayings.

verses.en: The preacher sought to find out acceptable words: and that which was written was upright, even words of truth.
verses.pt: Procurou o pregador achar palavras agradáveis, e escreveu com acerto discursos plenos de verdade.
verses.en_web: The Preacher sought to find out acceptable words, and that which was written blamelessly, words of truth.
verses.en_bbe: The Preacher made search for words which were pleasing, but his writing was in words upright and true.

verses.en: The words of the wise are as goads, and as nails fastened by the masters of assemblies, which are given from one shepherd.
verses.pt: As palavras dos sábios são como aguilhões; e como pregos bem fixados são as palavras coligidas dos mestres, as quais foram dadas pelo único pastor.
verses.en_web: The words of the wise are like goads; and like nails well fastened are words from the masters of assemblies, which are given from one shepherd.
verses.en_bbe: The words of the wise are pointed, and sayings grouped together are like nails fixed with a hammer; they are given by one guide.

verses.en: And further, by these, my son, be admonished: of making many books there is no end; and much study is a weariness of the flesh.
verses.pt: Além disso, filho meu, sê avisado. De fazer muitos livros não há fim; e o muito estudar é enfado da carne.
verses.en_web: Furthermore, my son, be admonished: of making many books there is no end; and much study is a weariness of the flesh.
verses.en_bbe: And further, my son, take note of this: of the making of books there is no end, and much learning is a weariness to the flesh.

verses.en: Let us hear the conclusion of the whole matter: Fear God, and keep his commandments: for this is the whole duty of man.
verses.pt: Este é o fim do discurso; tudo já foi ouvido: Teme a Deus, e guarda os seus mandamentos; porque isto é todo o dever do homem.
verses.en_web: This is the end of the matter. All has been heard. Fear God, and keep his commandments; for this is the whole duty of man.
verses.en_bbe: This is the last word. All has been said. Have fear of God and keep his laws; because this is right for every man.

verses.en: For God shall bring every work into judgment, with every secret thing, whether it be good, or whether it be evil.
verses.pt: Porque Deus há de trazer a juízo toda obra, e até tudo o que está encoberto, quer seja bom, quer seja mau.
verses.en_web: For God will bring every work into judgment, with every hidden thing, whether it is good, or whether it is evil.
verses.en_bbe: God will be judge of every work, with every secret thing, good or evil.
